members.text: To give birth is a way to produce. To give birth is to cause to be born. It is also called deliver, bear and birth.
A birth is a change. The birth is the event of being born. It is also called nativity, nascency and nascence.
A live birth is a birth. The live birth is the birth of a living fetus (regardless of the length of gestation).
A birthplace is a topographic point. The birthplace is the place where someone was born. It is also called place of birth.
To give birth is a way to create by mental act. To give birth is to create or produce an idea.

A childbirth is a parturition. The childbirth is the parturition process in human beings; having a baby; the process of giving birth to a child. It is also called childbearing, accouchement and vaginal birth.
A birth defect is a defect. The birth defect is a defect that is present at birth. It is also called congenital anomaly, congenital defect and congenital disorder.
A fetal age is an age. The fetal age is the age of an embryo counting from the time of fertilization. It is also called fertilization age and gestational age.
A baby is an undertaking. The baby is a project of personal concern to someone.
A birth canal is a passage. The birth canal is a passage in the uterus and vagina through which a fetus passes during vaginal birth.
A birth certificate is a certificate. The birth certificate is a copy of the official document giving details of a person's birth.
A birth is an actor. The birth is a baby born; an offspring.
A neonate is a baby. The neonate is a baby from birth to four weeks. It is also called newborn.
A premature baby is a neonate. The premature baby is an infant that is born prior to 37 weeks of gestation. It is also called preterm baby, premature infant and preterm infant.
A war baby is a baby. The war baby is conceived or born during war.
A birth is a beginning. The birth is the time when something begins (especially life).
A presentation is a show. The presentation is a show or display; the act of presenting something to sight or view. It is also called presentment and demonstration.
A broadcast is a show. The broadcast is a radio or television show. It is also called program and programme.
A broadcasting is a telecommunication. The broadcasting is taking part in a radio or tv program.
A television is a broadcasting. The television is broadcasting visual images of stationary or moving objects. It is also called telecasting, TV and video.
A presentation is a proposal. The presentation is the act of presenting a proposal.
A display is a show. The display is something shown to the public. It is also called exhibit and showing.
To show is a way to show. To show is to give an exhibition of to an interested audience. It is also called demo, exhibit and present.
A demonstration is a visual communication. The demonstration is a visual presentation showing how something works. It is also called demo.
A display is an electronic device. The display is an electronic device that represents information in visual form. It is also called video display.

A television is a telecommunication system. The television is a telecommunication system that transmits images of objects (stationary or moving) between distant points. It is also called television system.
A visual display unit is a display. The visual display unit is (British) British term for video display. It is also called VDU.
A presentation is a ceremony. The presentation is the activity of formally presenting something (as a prize or reward).
A presentation is a position. The presentation is (obstetrics) position of the fetus in the uterus relative to the birth canal.
A presenter is an advocate. The presenter is an advocate who presents a person (as for an award or a degree or an introduction etc.). It is also called sponsor.
A presenter is a communicator. The presenter is someone who presents a message of some sort (as a petition or an address or a check or a memorial etc.).
A slide is a foil. The slide is a transparency mounted in a frame; viewed with a slide projector. It is also called lantern slide.
A maneuver is a move. The maneuver is a move made to gain a tactical end. It is also called manoeuvre, tactical maneuver and tactical manoeuvre.
An operation is an activity. The operation is activity by a military or naval force (as a maneuver or campaign). It is also called military operation.

An operation is a medical procedure. The operation is a medical procedure involving an incision with instruments; performed to repair damage or arrest disease in a living body. It is also called surgery, surgical operation and surgical procedure.
A maneuver is a motion. The maneuver is a deliberate coordinated movement requiring dexterity and skill. It is also called manoeuvre and play.
To operate is a way to manipulate. To operate is to handle and cause to function. It is also called control.
An eye operation is an operation. The eye operation is any surgical procedure involving the eyes. It is also called eye surgery.
To function is a way to perform. To function is to perform as expected when applied. It is also called work, operate and go.
A maneuver is an evasion. The maneuver is an action aimed at evading an opponent. It is also called manoeuvre and evasive action.
An operation is an activity. The operation is a planned activity involving many people performing various actions.
A feint is a maneuver. The feint is any distracting or deceptive maneuver (as a mock attack).
An operation is an activity. The operation is the activity of operating something (a machine or business etc.).
An operation is a work. The operation is a process or series of acts especially of a practical or mechanical nature involved in a particular form of work. It is also called procedure.
A maneuver is an operation. The maneuver is a military training exercise. It is also called manoeuvre and simulated military operation.
An operation is a business activity. The operation is a business especially one run on a large scale.
An operations is a transaction. The operations is financial transactions at a brokerage; having to do with the execution of trades and keeping customer records. It is also called trading operations.

To manoeuver is a way to move. To manoeuver is to perform a movement in military or naval tactics in order to secure an advantage in attack or defense. It is also called maneuver, manoeuvre and operate.

A blackjack is a card game. The blackjack is a gambling game using cards; the object is to hold cards having a higher count than those dealt to the banker up to but not exceeding 21. It is also called twenty-one and vingt-et-un.
A poker is a card game. The poker is any of various card games in which players bet that they hold the highest-ranking hand. It is also called poker game.
A gambling is a diversion. The gambling is the act of playing for stakes in the hope of winning (including the payment of a price for a chance to win a prize). It is also called gaming and play.
To gamble is a way to play. To gamble is to play games for money.
To bet is a way to gamble. To bet is to stake on the outcome of an issue. It is also called wager and play.
A throw is a gambling. The throw is casting an object in order to determine an outcome randomly.
A bet is a gambling. The bet is the act of gambling. It is also called wager.
A lottery is a game of chance. The lottery is players buy (or are given) chances and prizes are distributed by casting lots. It is also called drawing.
To bet on is a way to bet. To bet on is to place a bet on. It is also called back, gage and stake.
A gambler is an actor. The gambler is a person who wagers money on the outcome of games or sporting events.
A sporting man is a gambler. The sporting man is a man who leads a merry existence; especially a gambler on the outcome of sporting events.
To play is a way to gamble. To play is to bet or wager (money).
To play is a way to bet. To play is to make bets.
A bettor is a gambler. The bettor is someone who bets. It is also called better, wagerer and punter.
A banking game is a game of chance. The banking game is any gambling game in which bets are laid against the gambling house or the dealer.

A Michigan is a card game. The Michigan is a gambling card game in which chips are placed on the ace and king and queen and jack of separate suits (taken from a separate deck); a player plays the lowest card of a suit in their hand and successively higher cards are played until the sequence stops; the player who plays a card matching one in the layout wins all the chips on that card. It is also called Chicago, Newmarket and boodle.
A social dancing is a dancing. The social dancing is dancing as part of a social occasion.
A social group is a group. The social group is people sharing some social relation.
A social event is an event. The social event is an event characteristic of persons forming groups.
A social science is a science. The social science is the branch of science that studies society and the relationships of individual within a society.
A sociology is a social science. The sociology is the study and classification of human societies.
A movement is a social group. The movement is a group of people with a common ideology who try together to achieve certain general goals. It is also called social movement and front.
A social station is a status. The social station is position in a social hierarchy. It is also called social status, social rank and rank.
A social work is a welfare work. The social work is any of various services designed to aid the poor and aged and to increase the welfare of children.
A social psychology is a psychology. The social psychology is the branch of psychology that studies persons and their relationships with others and with groups and with society as a whole.
A sociality is a nature. The sociality is the tendency to associate with others and to form social groups.
A social activity is a group action. The social activity is activity considered appropriate on social occasions.

A social insurance is a social welfare. The social insurance is government provision for unemployed, injured, or aged people; financed by contributions from employers and employees as well as by government revenue.
A social insect is an insect. The social insect is an insect that lives in a colony with other insects of the same species.
A social worker is a public servant. The social worker is someone employed to provide social services (especially to the disadvantaged). It is also called caseworker and welfare worker.
A social liberalism is a political orientation. The social liberalism is a political ideology that seeks to find a balance between individual liberty and social justice.

A social networking service is a web site. The social networking service is a platform to build social networks or social relations among people who share similar interests, activities, backgrounds or real-life connections.
An one-step is a ballroom dancing. The one-step is an early ballroom dance; precursor to the fox-trot.
A two-step is a ballroom dancing. The two-step is a ballroom dance in duple meter; marked by sliding steps.
A first step is a beginning. The first step is the first of a series of actions. It is also called initiative, opening move and opening.
To step is a way to move. To step is to move or proceed as if by steps into a new situation.
A step is a locomotion. The step is the act of changing location by raising the foot and setting it down.
A dance step is a locomotion. The dance step is a sequence of foot movements that make up a particular dance. It is also called step.
To step is a way to put. To step is to place (a ship's mast) in its step.
To heel is a way to dance. To heel is to perform with the heels.
To step is a way to travel. To step is to shift or move by taking a step.
To heel is a way to follow. To heel is to follow at the heels of a person.
To step is a way to travel. To step is to put down or press the foot, place the foot. It is also called tread.
To step is a way to walk. To step is to walk a short distance to a specified place or in a specified manner.
To step is a way to travel. To step is to move with one's feet in a specific manner.
To step on is a way to step. To step on is to place or press the foot on. It is also called tread on.
To step is a way to supply. To step is to furnish with steps.
To step is a way to run. To step is to cause (a computer) to execute a single command.
To wash one's hands is a way to absolve. To wash one's hands is to to absolve oneself of responsibility or future blame.
To wash is a way to clean. To wash is to cleanse with a cleaning agent, such as soap, and water. It is also called launder.
To wash is a way to separate. To wash is to separate dirt or gravel from (precious minerals).
To wash out is a way to discolor. To wash out is to lose color in the process of being washed.
To wash out is a way to discolor. To wash out is to drain off the color in the course of laundering.
To wash out is a way to weaken. To wash out is to deplete of strength or vitality.
To wash out is a way to wash. To wash out is to wash free from unwanted substances, such as dirt.
To wash out is a way to destroy. To wash out is to wear or destroy by the force of water.
To clean out is a way to deprive. To clean out is to deprive completely of money or goods.
To clean out is a way to displace. To clean out is to to eject from somewhere.
To handwash is a way to wash. To handwash is to wash or launder by hand instead of with a machine. It is also called hand-wash.
To machine wash is a way to wash. To machine wash is to wash by machine. It is also called machine-wash.
A washer is a white goods. The washer is a home appliance for washing clothes and linens automatically. It is also called automatic washer and washing machine.
To wash down is a way to flush. To wash down is to flow freely. It is also called flush down.
To wash down is a way to eat. To wash down is to eat food accompanied by lots of liquid; also use metaphorically.
To wash away is a way to remove. To wash away is to to set aside as irrelevant.
To fail is a way to act. To fail is to be unsuccessful. It is also called go wrong and miscarry.
A failure is a nonaccomplishment. The failure is an act that fails.
A failure is an unfortunate. The failure is a person with a record of failing; someone who loses consistently. It is also called loser, nonstarter and unsuccessful person.
To fail is a way to change. To fail is to stop operating or functioning. It is also called go bad, give way and die.
To lose is a way to act. To lose is to fail to keep or maintain (of a state).
To fail is a way to end. To fail is to prove insufficient. It is also called run out and give out.
To lose is a way to miss. To lose is to miss from one's possessions; lose sight of.
To miss is to be without. It is also called lack.
A failure is an omission. The failure is an unexpected omission.
A breach is a failure. The breach is a failure to perform some promised act or obligation.
To fail is a way to act. To fail is to fail to do something; leave something undone. It is also called neglect.
To miss is a way to fail. To miss is to fail to attend an event or activity.
A failure cost is a quality cost. The failure cost is the costs that arise from the products/services not conforming to the requirements.
A breakdown is a failure. The breakdown is a cessation of normal operation. It is also called equipment failure.
A failure is a disorder. The failure is loss of ability to function normally.
To miss is a way to act. To miss is to fail to perceive or to catch with the senses or the mind. It is also called lose.
To keep one's eyes peeled is a way to watch. To keep one's eyes peeled is to pay attention; be watchful. It is also called keep one's eyes skinned and keep one's eyes open.
To look away is a way to look. To look away is to avert one's gaze.
To see is a way to see. To see is to see and understand, have a good eye.
A must-see is a thing. The must-see is something which is considered required to see.
An eyeful is a view. The eyeful is a full view; a good look.
To behold is a way to see. To behold is to see with attention. It is also called lay eyes on.
To eye is a way to look. To eye is to look at. It is also called eyeball.
An eye is a hole. The eye is a small hole or loop (as in a needle).
An eye is a sagacity. The eye is good discernment (either visually or as if visually).
An eye is an attention. The eye is attention to what is seen.
An eyes is an opinion. The eyes is opinion or judgment.
An eyeful is a woman. The eyeful is a strikingly beautiful woman.
A view is an appearance. The view is outward appearance.
To stare is a way to look. To stare is to fixate one's eyes.
A stare is a look. The stare is a fixed look with eyes open wide.
A gaze is a stare. The gaze is a long fixed look. It is also called regard.
To add is a way to increase. To add is to make an addition (to); join or combine or unite with others; increase the quality, quantity, size or scope of.
To accumulate is a way to increase. To accumulate is to increase in amount by collecting or gathering. It is also called cumulate, conglomerate and pile up.
To total is a way to be. To total is to add up in number or quantity. It is also called number, add up and come.
To make is a way to total. To make is to add up to.
A consummation is a completion. The consummation is the act of bringing to completion or fruition.
To totalize is a way to compound. To totalize is to make into a total. It is also called totalise.
To total is a way to damage. To total is to damage beyond the point of repair.
To work out is a way to total. To work out is to be calculated.
To sum up is a way to repeat. To sum up is to give a summary (of). It is also called summarize, summarise and resume.
A sum is a whole. The sum is the whole amount. It is also called total, totality and aggregate.
A summation is a summary. The summation is a concluding summary (as in presenting a case before a law court). It is also called summing up and rundown.
A sum is a collection. The sum is the final aggregate. It is also called summation and sum total.
A summation is an arithmetic operation. The summation is the arithmetic operation of summing; calculating the sum of two or more numbers. It is also called addition.
To aggregate is a way to come. To aggregate is to amount in the aggregate to.
An aggregate is a sum. The aggregate is a sum total of many heterogenous things taken together. It is also called congeries and conglomeration.
To summarize is a way to state. To summarize is to be a summary of. It is also called summarise, sum and sum up.
A rich people is a people. The rich people is people who have possessions and wealth (considered as a group). It is also called rich.
A man of means is a rich person. The man of means is a person who is wealthy.
A rich person is an actor. The rich person is a person who possesses great material wealth. It is also called wealthy person and have.
A fat cat is a rich person. The fat cat is a wealthy and privileged person.
A wealth is a financial condition. The wealth is the state of being rich and affluent; having a plentiful supply of material goods and money. It is also called wealthiness.
A rich woman is a man of means. The rich woman is a woman who is wealthy. It is also called wealthy woman.
A rich man is a man of means. The rich man is a man who is wealthy. It is also called wealthy man.
A richness is a fruitfulness. The richness is the property of producing abundantly and sustaining vigorous and luxuriant growth. It is also called rankness, prolificacy and fertility.
A richness is a value. The richness is the quality of having high intrinsic value.
A wealth is a material resource. The wealth is an abundance of material possessions and resources. It is also called riches.
A treasure is a wealth. The treasure is accumulated wealth in the form of money or jewels etc. It is also called hoarded wealth.
A smart money is a people. The smart money is people who are highly experienced or who have inside information.
A wealth is a property. The wealth is property that has economic utility: a monetary value or an exchange value.
A money is a wealth. The money is wealth reckoned in terms of money.
A smart money is a speculation. The smart money is money bet or invested by experienced gamblers or investors (especially if they have inside information).
A lavishness is an expensiveness. The lavishness is the quality possessed by something that is excessively expensive. It is also called luxury, sumptuosity and sumptuousness.
To produce is a way to make. To produce is to bring forth or yield. It is also called bring forth.
To produce is a way to make. To produce is to create or manufacture a man-made product. It is also called make and create.
To make is a way to perform. To make is to perform, produce, or carry out.
To make is a way to amount. To make is to amount to.
A making is a component. The making is (usually plural) the components needed for making or doing something.
To produce is a way to expose. To produce is to bring out for display. It is also called bring forth.
To mass-produce is a way to manufacture. To mass-produce is to produce on a large scale.
To produce is a way to make. To produce is to cause to happen, occur or exist. It is also called bring about and give rise.
To produce is a way to act. To produce is to bring onto the market or release. It is also called bring on and bring out.
A producer is a cause. The producer is something that produces.
To machine is a way to produce. To machine is to make by machinery.
To fructify is a way to reproduce. To fructify is to produce fruit. It is also called set.
To offer is a way to produce. To offer is to produce or introduce on the stage.
To ferment is a way to convert. To ferment is to cause to undergo fermentation. It is also called work.
To metabolize is a way to produce. To metabolize is to produce by metabolism. It is also called metabolise.
A recipe is a direction. The recipe is directions for making something. It is also called formula.
To heat up is a way to intensify. To heat up is to make more intense. It is also called hot up and screw up.
To light up is a way to ignite. To light up is to begin to smoke. It is also called fire up and light.
To light up is a way to erupt. To light up is to start to burn with a bright flame.
To light up is a way to ignite. To light up is to ignite.
To bring up is a way to stop. To bring up is to cause to come to a sudden stop.
To point up is a way to stress. To point up is to emphasize, especially by identification.
To eat up is a way to eat. To eat up is to finish eating all the food on one's plate or on the table. It is also called finish and polish off.
To warm up is a way to fix. To warm up is to cause to do preliminary exercises so as to stretch the muscles.
To warm up is a way to change. To warm up is to become more friendly or open.
To warm is a way to change. To warm is to get warm or warmer. It is also called warm up.
A warm up is a preparation. The warm up is performing mild exercises to prepare for some more strenuous activity.
A warm-up is a preparation. The warm-up is exercising in preparation for strenuous activity. It is also called tune-up and prolusion.
To warm to is a way to consider. To warm to is to become excited about.
To warm up is a way to operate. To warm up is to run until the normal working temperature is reached.
To drive up is a way to approach. To drive up is to approach while driving.
To pen up is a way to restrain. To pen up is to confine in a fold, like sheep. It is also called fold.
A heat of dissociation is a heat. The heat of dissociation is the heat required for a fluid substance to break up into simpler constituents.
A dissociation energy is an energy. The dissociation energy is the energy needed to break every chemical bond in a molecule and completely separate all its atoms.

A dissociation is a psychological state. The dissociation is a state in which some integrated part of a person's life becomes separated from the rest of the personality and functions independently. It is also called disassociation.
A dissociative disorder is a dissociation. The dissociative disorder is dissociation so severe that the usually integrated functions of consciousness and perception of self break down.
A dissociation constant is an equilibrium constant. The dissociation constant is the equilibrium constant for a reversible dissociation.
A dispassion is an unemotionality. The dispassion is objectivity and detachment. It is also called dispassionateness and dryness.
A dissolution is a natural process. The dissolution is separation into component parts. It is also called disintegration.
To dissolve is a way to change. To dissolve is to declare void. It is also called dismiss.
To dissolve is a way to end. To dissolve is to come to an end (of a state). It is also called break up.
To dissolve is a way to end. To dissolve is to bring the association of to an end or cause to break up. It is also called break up.
To dissolve is a way to disintegrate. To dissolve is to pass into a solution.
To dissolve is a way to change state. To dissolve is to grow less and less substantial until it disappears. It is also called fade out and fade away.
To dissolve is a way to break down. To dissolve is to lose control emotionally.
To dissolve is a way to upset. To dissolve is to cause to lose control emotionally.
A dissolve is a transition. The dissolve is (film) a gradual transition from one scene to the next; the next scene is gradually superimposed as the former scene fades out.
A dissolving is a liquefaction. The dissolving is the process of going into solution. It is also called dissolution.
A glue is a cement. The glue is cement consisting of a sticky substance that is used as an adhesive. It is also called gum and mucilage.
A gum is an exudate. The gum is any of various substances (soluble in water) that exude from certain plants; they are gelatinous when moist but harden on drying.

An eucalyptus gum is a gum. The eucalyptus gum is reddish-brown dried gummy exudation from any of several trees of the genus Eucalyptus especially Eucalyptus camaldulensis. It is also called eucalyptus kino and red gum.
A chewing gum is a sweet. The chewing gum is a preparation (usually made of sweetened chicle) for chewing. It is also called gum.
A gum ball is a chewing gum. The gum ball is a ball of chewing gum with a coating of colored sugar.

A sweet gum is a liquidambar. The sweet gum is a North American tree of the genus Liquidambar having prickly spherical fruit clusters and fragrant sap. It is also called sweet gum tree, bilsted and red gum.
A sweet gum is a gum. The sweet gum is aromatic exudate from the sweet gum tree. It is also called liquidambar.
A sweet gum is a gumwood. The sweet gum is reddish-brown wood and lumber from heartwood of the sweet gum tree used to make furniture. It is also called satin walnut, hazelwood and red gum.
A gumwood is a wood. The gumwood is wood or lumber from any of various gum trees especially the sweet gum. It is also called gum.
A rose gum is a flooded gum. The rose gum is very tall tree of Queensland and New South Wales. It is also called Eucalypt grandis.
A spotted gum is an eucalyptus. The spotted gum is large gum tree with mottled bark. It is also called Eucalyptus maculata.

A snow gum is an eucalyptus. The snow gum is small to medium-sized tree of Australia and Tasmania having smooth white to light-grey bark shedding in patches or strips. It is also called ghost gum, white ash and Eucalyptus coriacea.
To gum is a way to exude. To gum is to exude or form gum.
A mumbling is a chew. The mumbling is ineffectual chewing (as if without teeth). It is also called gumming.
To gum is a way to change. To gum is to become sticky.
To gum up is a way to clog. To gum up is to stick together as if with gum.
A currency is a medium of exchange. The currency is the metal or paper medium of exchange that is presently used.
A coin is a coinage. The coin is a flat metal piece (usually a disc) used as money.
A rate of exchange is a rate. The rate of exchange is the charge for exchanging currency of one country for currency of another. It is also called exchange rate.
An exchange is a commerce. The exchange is reciprocal transfer of equivalent sums of money (especially the currencies of different countries). It is also called interchange.

A fluctuating exchange rate is a rate of exchange. The fluctuating exchange rate is the exchange rate in which the value of the currency is determined by the free market. It is also called floating exchange rate.
An exchange is a group action. The exchange is the act of changing one thing for another thing. It is also called interchange.
To exchange is a way to transfer. To exchange is to hand over one and receive another, approximately equivalent.
An exchange is a workplace. The exchange is a workplace for buying and selling; open only to members.
An exchangeability is a changeableness. The exchangeability is the quality of being capable of exchange or interchange. It is also called interchangeability, interchangeableness and fungibility.
An exchange is a capture. The exchange is (chess) the capture by both players (usually on consecutive moves) of pieces of equal value.
An exchange is a capture. The exchange is (chess) gaining (or losing) a rook in return for a knight or bishop.
An exchange is a transaction. The exchange is the act of giving something in return for something received.
A commodity exchange is an exchange. The commodity exchange is an exchange for buying and selling commodities for future delivery. It is also called commodities exchange and commodities market.
An exchange is a conversation. The exchange is a mutual expression of views (especially an unpleasant one).
An exchanger is a money handler. The exchanger is one whose business is to exchange the money of one country for that of another country. It is also called money changer.
An exchange is a chemical phenomenon. The exchange is chemical process in which one atom or ion or group changes places with another.
A drive is a trait. The drive is the trait of being highly motivated.
A drive is a device. The drive is (computer science) a device that writes data onto or reads data from a storage medium.
A drive is a physical condition. The drive is a physiological state corresponding to a strong need or desire.
A drive is a propulsion. The drive is the act of applying force to propel something. It is also called thrust and driving force.
A drive is a journey. The drive is a journey in a vehicle (usually an automobile). It is also called ride.
A drive is a return. The drive is (sports) a hard straight return (as in tennis or squash).
A drive is a golf stroke. The drive is hitting a golf ball off of a tee with a driver. It is also called driving.
To drive is a way to power. To drive is to cause to function by supplying the force or power for or by controlling.
A fluid drive is a coupling. The fluid drive is an automotive power coupling.
A test drive is a road test. The test drive is test of the roadworthiness of a vehicle one is considering buying.
To drive in is a way to score. To drive in is to score a run in baseball.
A test driver is a driver. The test driver is a driver who drives a motor vehicle to evaluate its performance.
A driver is a wood. The driver is a golf club (a wood) with a near vertical face that is used for hitting long shots from the tee. It is also called number one wood.
A driver is an utility program. The driver is (computer science) a program that determines how a computer will communicate with a peripheral device. It is also called device driver.
A driver is a golfer. The driver is a golfer who hits the golf ball with a driver.
An owner-driver is a driver. The owner-driver is a motorist who owns the car that he/she drives.
A side yard is a yard. The side yard is the grounds at either side of a house.
A picnic area is a tract. The picnic area is a tract of land set aside for picnicking. It is also called picnic ground.
A main yard is a yard. The main yard is yard for a square mainsail.
A yard is a spar. The yard is a long horizontal spar tapered at the end and used to support and spread a square sail or lateen.
A picnic is a meal. The picnic is any informal meal eaten outside or on an excursion.
A chicken yard is a yard. The chicken yard is an enclosed yard for keeping poultry. It is also called hen yard, chicken run and fowl run.
A yard is an enclosure. The yard is an enclosure for animals (as chicken or livestock).
A front yard is a yard. The front yard is the yard in front of a house; between the house and the street.
A yardstick is a rule. The yardstick is a ruler or tape that is three feet long. It is also called yard measure.

A yardgrass is a millet. The yardgrass is coarse annual grass having fingerlike spikes of flowers; native to Old World tropics; a naturalized weed elsewhere. It is also called yard grass, wire grass and goose grass.
A garden is a yard. The garden is a yard or lawn adjoining a house.
A backyard is a yard. The backyard is the grounds in back of a house.
A yard worker is a laborer. The yard worker is a laborer hired to do outdoor work (such as mowing lawns).
A yard worker is a railroader. The yard worker is worker in a railway yard.

A soft tree fern is a tree fern. The soft tree fern is of Australia and Tasmania; often cultivated; hardy in cool climates. It is also called Dicksonia antarctica.

A shield fern is a fern. The shield fern is any of various ferns of the genera Dryopteris or Polystichum or Lastreopsis having somewhat shield-shaped coverings on the sori. It is also called buckler fern.
A soft shield fern is a shield fern. The soft shield fern is European shield fern cultivated in many varieties. It is also called Polystichum setiferum.

A rose moss is a portulaca. The rose moss is widely cultivated in many varieties for its fleshy moss-like foliage and profusion of brightly colored flowers. It is also called sun plant and Portulaca grandiflora.

A silver tree fern is a tree fern. The silver tree fern is a showy tree fern of New Zealand and Australia having a crown of pinnated fronds with whitish undersides. It is also called sago fern, black tree fern and Cyathea medullaris.
A cliff brake is a fern. The cliff brake is any of several small lithophytic ferns of tropical and warm temperate regions. It is also called cliff-brake and rock brake.
A grape fern is a fern. The grape fern is a fern of the genus Botrychium having a fertile frond bearing small grapelike clusters of spore cases.
A fern seed is a spore. The fern seed is the asexual spore of ferns that resembles dust; once thought to be seeds and to make the possessor invisible.
A seed fern is a gymnosperm. The seed fern is an extinct seed-producing fernlike plant of the order Cycadofilicales (or group Pteridospermae). It is also called pteridosperm.
A polypody is a fern. The polypody is any of numerous ferns of the genus Polypodium.
A hard fern is a fern. The hard fern is any of several ferns of the genus Blechnum.
A grass fern is a fern. The grass fern is epiphytic fern found in lowland forests of tropical America. It is also called ribbon fern and Vittaria lineata.
A bladder fern is a fern. The bladder fern is any fern of the genus Cystopteris characterized by a hooded indusium or bladderlike membrane covering the sori.
A bulblet fern is a bladder fern. The bulblet fern is North American fern often bearing bulbils on the leaflets. It is also called bulblet bladder fern, berry fern and Cystopteris bulbifera.

A news article is an article. The news article is an article reporting news. It is also called news story and newspaper article.

A school newspaper is a newspaper. The school newspaper is a newspaper written and published by students in a school. It is also called school paper.
A news item is an item. The news item is an item in a newspaper.
A news program is a broadcast. The news program is a program devoted to current events, often using interviews and commentary. It is also called news show and news.

A newscast is a news. The newscast is a broadcast of news or commentary on the news.
A radio news is a newscast. The radio news is a radio broadcast of news.
A television news is a news program. The television news is a television broadcast of news.
A hard news is a news. The hard news is news that deals with serious topics or events.
A headline is a heading. The headline is the heading or caption of a newspaper article. It is also called newspaper headline.

A common beech is a beech. The common beech is large European beech with minutely-toothed leaves; widely planted as an ornamental in North America. It is also called European beech and Fagus sylvatica.
A beech fern is a fern. The beech fern is any fern of the genus Phegopteris having deeply cut triangular fronds.
A long beech fern is a beech fern. The long beech fern is beech fern of North America and Eurasia. It is also called narrow beech fern, northern beech fern and Phegopteris connectilis.
A southern beech is a tree. The southern beech is any of various beeches of the Southern Hemisphere having small usually evergreen leaves. It is also called evergreen beech.
A New Zealand beech is a southern beech. The New Zealand beech is any of several tall New Zealand trees of the genus Nothofagus; some yield useful timber.

A New York fern is a fern. The New York fern is slender shield fern of moist woods of eastern North America; sometimes placed in genus Dryopteris. It is also called Parathelypteris novae-boracensis and Dryopteris noveboracensis.
A wood fern is a fern. The wood fern is any of various ferns of the genus Dryopteris. It is also called wood-fern and woodfern.
A marginal wood fern is a wood fern. The marginal wood fern is North American fern with evergreen fronds. It is also called evergreen wood fern, leatherleaf wood fern and Dryopteris marginalis.
A red beech is an angiospermous tree. The red beech is large tree of Australasia. It is also called brown oak, booyong and crow's foot.
An American beech is a beech. The American beech is North American forest tree with light green leaves and edible nuts. It is also called white beech, red beech and Fagus grandifolia.
A hard beech is a southern beech. The hard beech is tall New Zealand tree yielding very hard wood. It is also called Nothofagus truncata.
A black beech is a southern beech. The black beech is New Zealand forest tree. It is also called Nothofagus solanderi and Nothofagus solandri.
A fern genus is a genus. The fern genus is genera of ferns and fern allies.
A chain fern is a fern. The chain fern is a fern of the genus Woodwardia having the sori in chainlike rows.

An angiopteris is a tree fern. The angiopteris is highly variable species of very large primitive ferns of the Pacific tropical areas with high rainfall. It is also called giant fern and Angiopteris evecta.

A broad beech fern is a beech fern. The broad beech fern is beech fern of North American woodlands having straw-colored stripes. It is also called southern beech fern, Phegopteris hexagonoptera and Dryopteris hexagonoptera.

A flowering fern is a fern. The flowering fern is any fern of the genus Osmunda: large ferns with creeping rhizomes; naked sporangia are on modified fronds that resemble flower clusters. It is also called osmund.
A flowering fern is a fern. The flowering fern is Australasian fern with clusters of sporangia on stems of fertile fronds. It is also called Helminthostachys zeylanica.
A male fern is a wood fern. The male fern is fern of North America and Europe whose rhizomes and stalks yield an oleoresin used to expel tapeworms. It is also called Dryopteris filix-mas.

A common polypody is a polypody. The common polypody is mat-forming lithophytic or terrestrial fern with creeping rootstocks and large pinnatifid fronds found throughout North America and Europe and Africa and east Asia. It is also called adder's fern, wall fern and golden maidenhair.
A holly fern is a fern. The holly fern is any of various ferns of the genus Polystichum having fronds with texture and gloss like holly.

A royal fern is a flowering fern. The royal fern is large deeply rooted fern of worldwide distribution with upright bipinnate compound tufted fronds. It is also called royal osmund, king fern and ditch fern.
A crepe fern is a fern. The crepe fern is fern of rain forests of tropical Australia and New Zealand and South Africa. It is also called king fern and Todea barbara.
A floating fern is an aquatic fern. The floating fern is aquatic fern of tropical America often used in aquariums. It is also called water sprite and Ceratopteris pteridioides.
A floating fern is an aquatic fern. The floating fern is pantropical aquatic fern. It is also called Ceratopteris thalictroides.

A holly fern is a fern. The holly fern is tropical Old World fern having glossy fronds suggestive of holly; sometimes placed in genus Polystichum. It is also called Cyrtomium aculeatum and Polystichum aculeatum.

An ostrich fern is a fern. The ostrich fern is tall fern of northern temperate regions having graceful arched fronds and sporophylls resembling ostrich plumes. It is also called shuttlecock fern, fiddlehead and Matteuccia struthiopteris.
A sword fern is a fern. The sword fern is any of several tropical ferns having more or less sword-shaped fronds including one from which the Boston fern developed.

A Boston fern is a sword fern. The Boston fern is a sword fern with arching or drooping pinnate fronds; a popular houseplant. It is also called Nephrolepis exaltata and Nephrolepis exaltata bostoniensis.
An annual fern is a fern. The annual fern is small short-lived fern of Central and South America. It is also called Jersey fern and Anogramma leptophylla.
A fern ally is a pteridophyte. The fern ally is pteridophytes of other classes than Filicopsida.
A whisk fern is a fern ally. The whisk fern is chiefly tropical clump-forming plants of skeletal appearance resembling whisk brooms; lacking roots.

A water closet is a toilet. The water closet is a toilet in Britain. It is also called closet, W.C. and loo.
A cupboard is a storage space. The cupboard is a small room (or recess) or cabinet used for storage space. It is also called closet.
A bedroom is a room. The bedroom is a room used primarily for sleeping. It is also called sleeping room, sleeping accommodation and chamber.
A wardrobe is a furniture. The wardrobe is a tall piece of furniture that provides storage space for clothes; has a door and rails or hooks for hanging clothes. It is also called closet and press.
A clean room is a room. The clean room is a room that is virtually free of dust or bacteria; used in laboratory work and in assembly or repair of precision equipment. It is also called white room.
A dressing room is a room. The dressing room is a room in which you can change clothes.

An emergency room is a hospital room. The emergency room is a room in a hospital or clinic staffed and equipped to provide emergency care to persons requiring immediate medical treatment. It is also called ER.
A ladies' room is a public toilet. The ladies' room is a woman's restroom in a public (or semipublic) building. It is also called powder room.
A pantry is a storeroom. The pantry is a small storeroom for storing foods or wines. It is also called larder and buttery.

A stillroom is a pantry. The stillroom is a pantry or storeroom connected with the kitchen (especially in a large house) for preparing tea and beverages and for storing liquors and preserves and tea etc. It is also called still room.
A storeroom is a room. The storeroom is a room in which things are stored. It is also called storage room and stowage.
A stockroom is a storeroom. The stockroom is storeroom for storing goods and supplies used in a business. It is also called stock room.
A television room is a room. The television room is a room set aside for viewing television. It is also called tv room.
A war room is a room. The war room is a room where strategic decisions are made (especially for military or political campaigns).
A Chinese brown sauce is a sauce. The Chinese brown sauce is a sauce based on soy sauce. It is also called brown sauce.
A tomato sauce is a spaghetti sauce. The tomato sauce is sauce made with a puree of tomatoes (or strained tomatoes) with savory vegetables and other seasonings; can be used on pasta.
A spaghetti sauce is a sauce. The spaghetti sauce is any of numerous sauces for spaghetti or other kinds of pasta. It is also called pasta sauce.
A white sauce is a sauce. The white sauce is milk thickened with a butter and flour roux. It is also called bechamel sauce and bechamel.
A pepper sauce is a sauce. The pepper sauce is for venison: brown sauce with sauteed vegetables and trimmings and marinade and plenty of pepper. It is also called poivrade.
A cranberry sauce is a condiment. The cranberry sauce is sauce made of cranberries and sugar.
A duck sauce is a condiment. The duck sauce is a thick sweet and pungent Chinese condiment. It is also called hoisin sauce.
A soy sauce is a condiment. The soy sauce is thin sauce made of fermented soy beans. It is also called soy.
A bolognese pasta sauce is a spaghetti sauce. The bolognese pasta sauce is sauce for pasta; contains mushrooms and ham and chopped vegetables and beef and tomato paste.
A bread sauce is a sauce. The bread sauce is creamy white sauce made with bread instead of flour and seasoned with cloves and onion.
A cheese sauce is a white sauce. The cheese sauce is white sauce with grated cheese.
A cream sauce is a white sauce. The cream sauce is white sauce made with cream.
A mushroom sauce is a sauce. The mushroom sauce is brown sauce and sauteed mushrooms.
A cranberry is a berry. The cranberry is very tart red berry used for sauce or juice.
A marinara is a spaghetti sauce. The marinara is sauce for pasta; contains tomatoes and garlic and herbs.
A mountain ash is an angiospermous tree. The mountain ash is any of various trees of the genus Sorbus.
An ash is a tree. The ash is any of various deciduous pinnate-leaved ornamental or timber trees of the genus Fraxinus. It is also called ash tree.
A white ash is an ash. The white ash is spreading American ash with leaves pale green or silvery beneath and having hard brownish wood. It is also called Fraxinus americana.
A flowering ash is an ash. The flowering ash is shrubby ash of southwestern United States having fragrant white flowers. It is also called Fraxinus cuspidata.
A flowering ash is an ash. The flowering ash is shrubby California ash with showy off-white flowers. It is also called Fraxinus dipetala.
A manna ash is an ash. The manna ash is southern Mediterranean ash having fragrant white flowers in dense panicles and yielding manna. It is also called flowering ash and Fraxinus ornus.

A white mountain ash is an eucalyptus. The white mountain ash is large tree with dark compact bark on lower trunk but smooth and white above; yields lumber similar to that of European or American ashes. It is also called Eucalyptus fraxinoides.
An American mountain ash is a mountain ash. The American mountain ash is a variety of mountain ash. It is also called Sorbus americana.
A mountain ash is an ash. The mountain ash is low-growing ash of Texas. It is also called Fraxinus texensis.
A mountain ash is an eucalyptus. The mountain ash is tree having wood similar to the alpine ash; tallest tree in Australia and tallest hardwood in the world. It is also called Eucalyptus regnans.
A rowan is a mountain ash. The rowan is Eurasian tree with orange-red berrylike fruits. It is also called rowan tree, European mountain ash and Sorbus aucuparia.
A Western mountain ash is a mountain ash. The Western mountain ash is an ash of the western coast of North America. It is also called Sorbus sitchensis.
A prickly ash is a tree. The prickly ash is any of a number of trees or shrubs of the genus Zanthoxylum having spiny branches.

A mountain laurel is a kalmia. The mountain laurel is a North American evergreen shrub having glossy leaves and white or rose-colored flowers. It is also called wood laurel, American laurel and calico bush.
A native beech is a silver ash. The native beech is tall Australian timber tree yielding tough hard wood used for staves etc. It is also called flindosa, flindosy and Flindersia australis.

An andromeda is a shrub. The andromeda is broad-leaved evergreen Asiatic shrub with glossy leaves and drooping clusters of white flowers. It is also called Japanese andromeda, lily-of-the-valley tree and Pieris japonica.
A shrublet is a shrub. The shrublet is dwarf shrub.

A spicebush is a shrub. The spicebush is deciduous shrub of the eastern United States having highly aromatic leaves and bark and yellow flowers followed by scarlet or yellow berries. It is also called spice bush, American spicebush and Benjamin bush.

A daisybush is a shrub. The daisybush is any of various mostly Australian attractively shaped shrubs of the genus Olearia grown for their handsome and sometimes fragrant evergreen foliage and profusion of daisy flowers with white or purple or blue rays. It is also called daisy-bush and daisy bush.

A dwarf bilberry is a blueberry. The dwarf bilberry is low-growing tufted deciduous shrub of northern and alpine North America having pink to coral-red flowers followed by sweet blue berries. It is also called dwarf blueberry and Vaccinium caespitosum.
A bush clover is a woody plant. The bush clover is shrubby or herbaceous plants widely used for forage, soil improvement, and especially hay in southern United States. It is also called lespedeza.
A coral bush is a shrub. The coral bush is Australian shrub having simple obovate leaves and brilliant scarlet flowers. It is also called flame bush and Templetonia retusa.
A beauty bush is a shrub. The beauty bush is Chinese deciduous shrub with yellow-throated pinkish flowers and bristly fruit; often cultivated as an ornamental. It is also called Kolkwitzia amabilis.

A cranberry bush is a shrub. The cranberry bush is deciduous North American shrub or small tree having three-lobed leaves and red berries. It is also called cranberry tree, American cranberry bush and highbush cranberry.
A currant is a shrub. The currant is any of various deciduous shrubs of the genus Ribes bearing currants. It is also called currant bush.

A marmalade bush is a shrub. The marmalade bush is evergreen South American shrub having showy trumpet-shaped orange flowers; grown as an ornamental or houseplant. It is also called fire bush, fire-bush and Streptosolen jamesonii.
A Jewbush is a slipper spurge. The Jewbush is low tropical American shrub having powerful emetic properties. It is also called Jew-bush, Jew bush and redbird cactus.
A flowering quince is a shrub. The flowering quince is Asiatic ornamental shrub with spiny branches and pink or red blossoms.

A gooseberry is a shrub. The gooseberry is spiny Eurasian shrub having greenish purple-tinged flowers and ovoid yellow-green or red-purple berries. It is also called gooseberry bush, Ribes uva-crispa and Ribes grossularia.

A base metal is a metallic element. The base metal is a metal that is common and not considered precious.
A cadmium is a metallic element. The cadmium is a soft bluish-white ductile malleable toxic bivalent metallic element; occurs in association with zinc ores. It is also called Cd and atomic number 48.

A cesium is a metallic element. The cesium is a soft silver-white ductile metallic element (liquid at normal temperatures); the most electropositive and alkaline metal. It is also called caesium, Cs and atomic number 55.
A noble metal is a metallic element. The noble metal is any metal that is resistant to corrosion or oxidation.

A gold is a noble metal. The gold is a soft yellow malleable ductile (trivalent and univalent) metallic element; occurs mainly as nuggets in rocks and alluvial deposits; does not react with most chemicals but is attacked by chlorine and aqua regia. It is also called Au and atomic number 79.

A magnesium is a metallic element. The magnesium is a light silver-white ductile bivalent metallic element; in pure form it burns with brilliant white flame; occurs naturally only in combination (as in magnesite and dolomite and carnallite and spinel and olivine). It is also called Mg and atomic number 12.

A mercury is a metallic element. The mercury is a heavy silvery toxic univalent and bivalent metallic element; the only metal that is liquid at ordinary temperatures. It is also called quicksilver, hydrargyrum and Hg.

A nickel is a metallic element. The nickel is a hard malleable ductile silvery metallic element that is resistant to corrosion; used in alloys; occurs in pentlandite and smaltite and garnierite and millerite. It is also called Ni and atomic number 28.

An osmium is a metallic element. The osmium is a hard brittle blue-grey or blue-black metallic element that is one of the platinum metals; the heaviest metal known. It is also called Os and atomic number 76.

A platinum is a noble metal. The platinum is a heavy precious metallic element; grey-white and resistant to corroding; occurs in some nickel and copper ores and is also found native in some deposits. It is also called Pt and atomic number 78.

A rhodium is a metallic element. The rhodium is a white hard metallic element that is one of the platinum group and is found in platinum ores; used in alloys with platinum. It is also called Rh and atomic number 45.

A silver is a noble metal. The silver is a soft white precious univalent metallic element having the highest electrical and thermal conductivity of any metal; occurs in argentite and in free form; used in coins and jewelry and tableware and photography. It is also called Ag and atomic number 47.

A thulium is a metallic element. The thulium is a soft silvery metallic element of the rare earth group; isotope 170 emits X-rays and is used in small portable X-ray machines; it occurs in monazite and apatite and xenotime. It is also called Tm and atomic number 69.

A southwest by south is a compass point. The southwest by south is the compass point that is one point south of southwest. It is also called SWbS.
A west by south is a compass point. The west by south is the compass point that is one point south of due west. It is also called WbS.
A south is a direction. The south is the direction corresponding to the southward cardinal compass point.
A southwest by west is a compass point. The southwest by west is the compass point that is one point west of southwest. It is also called SWbW.

A southwest is a compass point. The southwest is the compass point midway between south and west; at 225 degrees. It is also called sou'-west, southwestward and SW.
A southwest is a direction. The southwest is the direction corresponding to the southwestward compass point.

An evening is a time period. The evening is a later concluding time period.
